d:
Presenting a calming collection of Indian classical melodies featuring the gentle sounds of Santoor and Bansuri. featuring the legendary maestros Pandit Shivkumar Sharma (Santoor) and Pandit Hariprasad Chaurasia (Bansuri).
The soothing blend of Santoor and Bansuri offers a timeless musical experience that complements meditation, yoga, reading, studying, or simply unwinding after a busy day. Let these beautiful ragas fill your space with tranquility and mindfulness.
Credit:
Album: Rasdhara
Artist: Pandit Shivkumar Sharma & Pandit Hariprasad Chaurasia
Instrument : Santoor & Bansuri
